about_the_game:
This is a first-person walking simulator combined with life simulation elements, featuring horror and psychological suspense.

Story:
You play as a young person with a sixth sense for the supernatural. To save money, you rent an unusually cheap apartment. You thought you could coexist with "them" as you always have—but soon realize that the anomalies here are far deeper and more dangerous than anything you've faced before. Each sleepless night in this haunted apartment brings you closer to the truth...

Features:

  • Play as someone with a supernatural sensitivity. Sense and dispel the strange occurrences that appear each night.

  • Paranormal events affect your sanity. Interact with objects in the apartment to recover your mental state.

  • Uncover the terrifying history of the room through the events that unfold each night.

    Demo Version Notes:

    • The demo includes a simplified version of the first 4 nights.

    • The demo is little to no story — the focus is on visuals, atmosphere, and jumpscares. The full version will include the complete plot.

    • The demo player is limited to the apartment interior.

      The demo takes around 10 minutes to complete.
